records.source_meaning: A formal report states that the enemy flagship has fled and that our side has won.
records.english: The enemy flagship fled! We've won!
records.localization_note: The enemy flagship fled! We've won! preserves both explicit facts and the relief and certainty of the report in idiomatic speech. The contraction suits a spoken victory announcement without changing its factual meaning. No Admiral address appears here;none is added. Fled does not imply sinking,capture or the enemy admiral's death.
